text: Sync takes forever and I lost two days of notes while offline on a flight.
Offline mode is basically broken. I'm a student and can't rely on it in class.
Edits I made on the subway vanished when it reconnected. Lost a whole lecture's notes.
App is so slow to open on my iPhone, by the time it loads the lecture moved on.
Works on wifi but the second I lose signal it's useless. No real offline support.
Would happily pay for a lighter version that's fast and offline-first.
